entities.name: Şaziye Erdoğan
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Şaziye Erdoğan-Okur is a Turkish weightlifter competing in the Women's −45 kg division. Okur is the current world record holder in the −44 kg division of youth category with 77 kg in the snatch, 92 kg in the clean & jerk events and 169 kg in total.
